pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā bhikkhunī Sāvatthiyaṃ aññatarissā visikhāya piṇḍāya caramānā yena aññataraṃ kulaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:1.3: atha kho te manussā taṃ bhikkhuniṃ bhojetvā etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:1.6: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo nāgaccheyyun ti bhikkhuniyo upasaṃkamitvā etad avoca:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:1.7: amukasmiṃ ayye okāse vālā sunakhā caṇḍo balibaddo cikkhallo okāso,
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:1.9: aññatarāpi bhikkhunī tassā visikhāya piṇḍāya caramānā yena taṃ kulaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:1.10: atha kho te manussā taṃ bhikkhuniṃ bhojetvā etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:1.12: atha kho sā bhikkhunī tesaṃ manussānaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:1.14: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhunī kulaṃ maccharāyissatīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:1.15: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhunī kulaṃ maccharāyatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:1.18: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhunī kulaṃ maccharāyissati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:1.21.1: yā pana bhikkhunī kulamaccharinī assa, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:2.1.8: kathaṃ bhikkhuniyo nāgaccheyyun ti bhikkhunīnaṃ santike kulassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:2.1.9: kulassa vā santike bhikkhunīnaṃ avaṇṇaṃ bhāsati, āpatti pācittiyassa. ||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc55:2.2.2: kulaṃ na maccharāyantī santaṃ yeva ādīnavaṃ ācikkhati,
